decisions.reason: The source specifically changes referral-validation popup behavior and copy; it does not require corresponding FAQ content changes.
The referral popup decision does not alter the Mission page's existing referral or prize-pool presentation.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures that tickets allocated for invalid or absent referral codes participate through the randomly selected existing NFT holder.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records ticket issuance for both no-referral and invalid-referral mints and removes the obsolete no-referral-only key.
The source changes referral-code validity and reward allocation, not how prize winners receive or are notified about prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already extends the trigger from absent codes to absent or invalid codes; the recipient and reward components remain unchanged.
The popup-specific referral decision does not change landing-page hero copy or layout.
Referral-code validation and fallback reward routing do not change fiat-buyer wallet provisioning or reward access.
The source specifies popup messages and reward routing, not transactional email delivery or email contents.
The referral popup decision does not change the deferred Transak integration, supported payment methods, or purchase fulfillment.
The source has no effect on landing-page book-cover placement, size, cropping, or visibility.
The source changes who receives the existing $5 commission and prize ticket for invalid or absent codes, not the primary-mint amounts or revenue split.
